top_signals.title: Exxon Warns Kazakhstan’s Top Oil Field to Peak Within Years
top_signals.summary: ExxonMobil Holdings Corp. has told Kazakhstan that the country’s top oil field is already on the cusp of peak output and its production will slump sharply in the coming decade.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
